scope: Read-quality/origin follow-up of6 primary discordances plus3 MAPQ60-only sites, unchanged prior triage design/v2

loci.finding: All 208 qualifying unexpected-A alignment observations (116 name units) are within 5 bases of an aligned query end;190 are at stored query position0, and all 208 at aligned query start. Clean filtering removes all 116 A names but retains 183 G names. All 8 selected unexpected sequences best match ordinary COL5A2 transcripts at the same position (7 perfect,1 with another mismatch). This is an end-dependent observation, not proof of a paralog or of the cause of the end bias.
loci.limits: Representative sequences/families are not independent molecules. First-best nominated alignments and allele-substituted original-CIGAR models are hypotheses, not validated true read origins.

loci.finding: Baseline DNA C713/T28 and RNA C72/T153 become DNA C230/T0 with RNA unchanged underMAPQ60. The2 selected DNA-T sequences (7 baseline names) each match161bp perfectly at FANCD2P2, with queried base at chr3:11871392 one-based, versus one mismatch to public FANCD2; changing the FANCD2 source-path allele toT also yields a perfect score. RNA-T representatives retain the T at FANCD2. The ordinary pseudogene match documents ambiguity, not proof that DNA-T reads originate from the pseudogene or that the locus is incompatible.

loci.finding: All 37 qualifying C-bearing alignment observations (27 names) have a nearby 4bp insertion at boundary chr3:195568840 zero-based, within a G-rich run. In first-best nominated ordinary local alignments, the queried C falls within an insertion for7/8 selected sequences and at a nearby different position for1/8. These alternatives can score below a source-CIGAR model containing the unexpected allele (example 278 versus 283); they demonstrate placement ambiguity, not correction of all 27 names or proof of biological origin. Clean C24/G0 has reduced depth, not resolution.

loci.finding: The locus is in a GCG-rich repeat. All 37 qualifying A-bearing alignment observations (22 names) have a21-base N operation at chr5:[443260,443281) zero-based. In8/8 selected sequences the queried A moves to the matching reference A at chr5:443280 one-based in first-best nominated ordinary local alignments (+21bases). Example ordinary score292 is below the source-CIGAR/unexpected-allele score310, so origin is not adjudicated. Several expected-C sequences are short/softclipped and have other repeat matches. Seed/window caps affect EXOC3 representatives; no uniqueness or exhaustive-best claim.
loci.limits: Representative sequences/families are not independent molecules. First-best nominated alignments and allele-substituted original-CIGAR models are hypotheses, not validated true read origins.

loci.finding: The position overlaps MSH3 and DHFR in opposite orientations. Among 189 qualifying G-bearing alignment observations (104 names),147 have a27-base N at chr5:[80654887,80654914);42 have the nearby 1446-base splice instead. All 8 selected sequences place the queried G at matching reference chr5:80654908 one-based (−9bases) in their first-best nominated ordinary alignment, including MSH3 or reverse-complement DHFR models. Source-CIGAR/unexpected-allele models can score higher (example 290 versus 259), so these are alternative gap placements, not a validated preferred origin or changed genotype.
loci.limits: Representative sequences/families are not independent molecules. First-best nominated alignments and allele-substituted original-CIGAR models are hypotheses, not validated true read origins.

method.note_observations: Observations can repeat across the two adjacent PABPC1 sites; not a count of unique BAM alignments.
method.selection: Per site, at most8 unexpected RNA+4 expected RNA+2 unexpected DNA distinct stored sequences; rank by descending name support then lexical sequence. Names deduplicated across selected sequences in coverage summaries.

search.seed_placements: disjoint19nt blocks plus terminal19mer, both orientations
search.cap_scope: Patient seed/window caps affect EXOC3 representatives; repeat control also capped. No exhaustive-search or unique-origin claim.

method.controls: 6 manual CIGAR position tests; baseline/clean count equality atall9 loci;7 ordinary-parent/edit/splice expected-score/source-window controls; ambiguous repeat control; root670 exported affine scores+7 scalar controls all match independent recurrence.

PABPC1_shared_support.note: Same-query and same-record observations, not UMI-independent molecules or genomic phase proof.

limits: No identity probability, contamination fraction, clinical diagnosis or treatment inference.
RNA fractions and clean/MAPQ filters do not by themselves establish source, biology or resolution.
Selected sequences are a bounded subset; omissions and selection denominators are explicit.
Search excludes unrepresented alternate haplotypes and arbitrary unannotated splicing;19nt seed nomination may miss gapped alternatives.
One best traceback is reported; repeat-equivalent placements are not exhaustively enumerated.
Original-CIGAR path/allele models can outscore ordinary references; their structural form follows the original alignment and is not independent proof of origin.
No new full alignment/download/upload or full patient BAM scan.
